found_at: https://go.actionstep.com/frontend/application/auth/login (the app's login page; the logo is set in Layout-Login.css / as-main.css)
edits: kept only the arch 'A' and its small square (elements 2,3); removed the rest of the 'Actionstep' wordmark
cropped the viewBox to the mark with a 2% pad

dark file is the company's own white logo, not a recolour: https://www.actionstep.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/as-desktop-head-logo.svg (actionstep.com header, downloads/actionstep/src2/as-desktop-head-logo.svg), same elements 2,3 kept, cropped and cleaned; it derives against that file
notes: No standalone logomark SVG was published anywhere I found (no brand/press page; docs, status page and favicons are PNG), so the mark comes out of the wordmark SVGs, where it is a separate pair of paths. Actionstep's app icon (docs PWA icon, the current staging file) puts the white A on a #024638 tile; no vector of that tile exists, so the tile is not reproduced. actionstep.com's own favicon uses a lighter green (about #6BA54A) for the A; the dark green #024638 here matches the logomark file and the app. The dark file carries the source's own 1.27 white stroke on its paths, so its A is a hair bolder than the light one.
license: Actionstep brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Actionstep.
